# Aurex — LLM & Agent Reference

> Local-first LLM cost tracking, real-time budget guards, and zero-PII telemetry sync. Prompts/responses are hashed locally; cloud sync sends metadata only unless `sync_prompt_hashes` is enabled.

This file is the primary entry point for AI coding agents. Use the routing table below to open the correct doc page before writing integration code.

---

## Agent routing (task → doc URL)

All paths are relative to the site origin (e.g. `https://your-host/docs/installation`).

| If the user wants to… | Open this URL |
| :--- | :--- |
| Understand what Aurex does | `/docs` |
| Install SDK, set API key, first event | `/docs/installation` |
| Set env vars (`AUREX_API_KEY`, ledger path) | `/docs/installation#env-vars` |
| Zero-code auto-hook (`install-hook`) | `/docs/reference#autohook` |
| Manual init + `log_event` / `logEvent` | `/docs/reference#integration` |
| Full `AurexConfig` / `getInstance` options | `/docs/reference#config-reference` |
| Budget guard / circuit breaker setup | `/docs/reference#budget-guard-config` |
| Supported providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) | `/docs/reference#provider-matrix` |
| Pre-call guards (`pre_call_check`) | `/docs/reference#guards` |
| Request-scoped `wrap()` / `awrap()` | `/docs/reference#context-wrappers` |
| Success/failure outcome signals | `/docs/reference#outcomes` |
| Health, crash recovery, `flush()` | `/docs/reference#health-monitoring` |
| Deploy to Lambda, K8s, read-only FS | `/docs/deployment` |
| Serverless flush before handler return | `/docs/deployment#serverless-flush` |
| Writable ledger fallback (`/tmp`, memory) | `/docs/deployment#readonly-fs` |
| Cloud sync retries, 429, queue drops | `/docs/deployment#network-resilience` |
| Pick patch vs wrap vs manual logging | `/docs/harness` |
| Avoid double-counting with existing wrapper | `/docs/harness#decision-matrix` |
| Offline heuristics CLI | `/docs/reference#heuristics` |
| CI policy gate | `/docs/reference#cicd` |

## Environment variables

| Variable | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- |
| `AUREX_API_KEY` | Project API key (`aux_dev_*`, `aux_*`, `ax_live_*`) |
| `AUREX_BASE_URL` | Backend base URL (default `http://localhost:8000/api/v1`) |
| `AUREX_ENABLED` | Set `1` for auto-hook to activate |
| `AUREX_LEDGER_PATH` | Override ledger file path (use `/tmp/...` in read-only/serverless) |
| `AUREX_WORKER_ID` | Suffix for per-process ledger filenames in multi-worker setups |
| `AUREX_SYNC_PROMPT_HASHES` | Set `1` to sync prompt/response hashes to cloud |
| `AUREX_PRICING_PATH` | Path to custom model pricing JSON |
| `AUREX_DEBUG` | Set `1` for verbose SDK debug logs (Python) |

---

## Public SDK API

Both SDKs use a **singleton**. Call `AurexAuditor.reset()` (Python class method) or `AurexAuditor.reset()` (Node static) in tests before re-configuring.

### Python (`aurex-sdk`)

- **Import**: `from aurex_sdk import AurexAuditor, AurexConfig, AurexDecision, AurexAction, AurexBudgetExceeded, AurexBlocked, AurexConfigError`
- **Init**: `auditor = AurexAuditor(AurexConfig(...))`
- **Reset (tests)**: `AurexAuditor.reset()`
- **Patch** (guarded with `__aurex_patched__`): `patch_all()`, `patch_openai()`, `patch_anthropic()`, `patch_google()`, `patch_litellm()`, `patch_ollama()`, `patch_huggingface()`
- **Guards**: `pre_call_check(...) -> AurexDecision`, `configure_circuit_breaker(dict)`
- **Log**: `log_event(model, prompt, response, input_tokens, output_tokens, ...)`
- **Outcomes**: `mark_success(workflow_id)`, `mark_failure(workflow_id, reason)`
- **Flush**: `flush()`, `flush_async(timeout=30.0) -> bool`, `shutdown()`
- **Health**: `get_health() -> dict` (includes `queue_size`, `events_dropped`, `sync_error_count`, `patch_status`, `storage_mode`, `ledger_path`)
- **Wrap**: `wrap(call_fn, build_params, options)`, `awrap(...)`

### Node.js (`aurex-sdk`)

- **Import**: `import { AurexAuditor, AurexBudgetExceeded } from "aurex-sdk"`
- **Init**: `AurexAuditor.getInstance(config)`
- **Reset (tests)**: `AurexAuditor.reset()`
- **Patch**: `patchAll()`, `patchOpenAI()`, `patchAnthropic()`, `patchLiteLLM()`, `patchOllama()`, `patchHuggingFace()`, `patchGoogle()`
- **Guards**: `preCallCheck({...})`, `configureCircuitBreaker(config)`
- **Log**: `logEvent({ model, inputTokens, outputTokens, workflowId, ... })`
- **Outcomes**: `markSuccess(workflowId)`, `markFailure(workflowId, reason)`
- **Flush**: `flush()`, `flushAndWait(timeoutMs?) -> Promise<boolean>`, `shutdownAsync()`
- **Health**: `getHealth()` (includes `eventsDropped`, `patchStatus`, `storageMode`)
- **Wrap**: `auditor.wrap(callFn, buildParams, options)`

### Typed errors

- `AurexBudgetExceeded` — budget guard `on_budget_exceeded: "throw"` (fields: `workflowId`, `limit`, `current`)
- `AurexBlocked` — guard blocked the call
- `AurexConfigError` — invalid configuration

---

## Configuration reference

### Core AurexConfig fields

| Option | Python | Node.js | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| API key | `api_key` | `apiKey` | env / None | Project key (`aux_*`). Required for cloud sync. |
| Project | `project` | `project` | `"default"` | Logical project name (legacy); key binds project server-side. |
| Ledger path | `ledger_path` | `ledgerPath` | `.aurex/ledger.jsonl` | Local JSONL ledger. Overridable via `AUREX_LEDGER_PATH`. |
| Per-process ledger | `per_process_ledger` | `perProcessLedger` | `True` | Append `.<worker_id>` to filename to avoid multi-worker contention. Set `False` in unit tests. |
| Cloud sync | `cloud_sync` | `cloudSync` | `False` / auto if key | Async POST to `/api/v1/ledger/events`. Node defaults true when `apiKey` set. |
| Cloud endpoint | `cloud_endpoint` | `cloudEndpoint` | derived from base URL | Ingest URL; usually `.../ledger/events`. |
| Base URL | `base_url` | `baseUrl` | localhost API | Backend API root. |
| Local only | `local_only` | `localOnly` | `True` | Skip cloud sync even if key present. |
| Storage mode | `storage_mode` | `storageMode` | `"file"` | `"file"` or `"memory"`. Auto-fallback to memory if FS unwritable. |
| Flush interval | `flush_interval_seconds` | `flushIntervalMs` | 30s / 30000ms | Background batch flush interval. |
| Max batch size | `max_batch_size` | `maxBatchSize` | 100 | Events per flush batch. |
| Max queue size | `max_queue_size` | `maxQueueSize` | 10000 | Bounded in-memory queue; overflow spills to disk or increments `events_dropped`. |
| Sync timeout | `sync_timeout_seconds` | `syncTimeoutMs` | 10s / 10000ms | HTTP timeout per cloud sync attempt. |
| Sync max retries | `sync_max_retries` | `syncMaxRetries` | 3 | Retries with backoff; respects HTTP 429 `Retry-After`. |
| Sync hashes | `sync_prompt_hashes` | `syncPromptHashes` | False | Include prompt/response hashes in cloud payload. |
| Pricing path | `pricing_path` | `pricingPath` | None | Custom model pricing JSON. |
| Default pricing | `default_pricing` | `defaultPricing` | 1.50 / 6.00 | Fallback USD per 1M tokens for unknown models. |
| Budget guard | `budget_guard` | `budgetGuard` | {} | See BudgetGuard below. |

### BudgetGuard

Under `budget_guard` (Python) / `budgetGuard` (Node):

- `max_cost_per_minute` / `maxCostPerMinute` — USD per rolling minute
- `max_cost_per_session` / `maxCostPerSession` — USD per `workflow_id`
- `max_requests_per_minute` / `maxRequestsPerMinute` — request count cap
- `max_context_tokens` / `maxContextTokens` — estimated input token cap
- `on_budget_exceeded` / `onBudgetExceeded` — `"throw"` | `"warn"` | `"webhook"` (throws `AurexBudgetExceeded` when `"throw"`)
- `webhook_url` / `webhookUrl` — POST target for webhook mode
- `dry_run` / `dryRun` — evaluate but never block

Per-request overrides: pass `budget_guard` inside `wrap()` / `awrap()` options.

---

## Cloud integration checklist

1. Set `AUREX_LEDGER_PATH=/tmp/.aurex/ledger.jsonl` when filesystem is read-only (Lambda).
2. Enable `per_process_ledger` for multiple workers on shared storage.
3. Call `flush()` (Python) or `await flushAndWait()` (Node) at end of short-lived handlers.
4. Monitor `get_health()` / `getHealth()` for `sync_error_count`, `events_dropped`, `status: "degraded"`.
5. Backend ingest is rate-limited per API key (~600 req/min); SDK retries on 429.
6. Escalations endpoint accepts API keys (`POST /api/v1/escalations`) for SDK-triggered Slack alerts.

---

## Backend API (SDK-facing)

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `POST /api/v1/ledger/events` | Bearer `aux_*` API key (`ledger:write` scope) | Batch telemetry ingest |
| `POST /api/v1/escalations` | Bearer API key or JWT | Human-in-the-loop Slack escalation |

Cloud sync payload for ledger ingest: `{ "events": [ { ...event fields, "cost_usd": <float> } ] }`

---

## CLI

**Python**
- `aurex install-hook [--target TARGET]`
- `aurex uninstall-hook [--target TARGET]`
- `aurex audit [--ledger PATH] [--fail-under SCORE] [--max-waste-usd USD] [--mode warn|block]`

**Node**
- `npx aurex install-hook [target]`
- `npx aurex uninstall-hook [target]`
- `npx aurex ci [--mode=warn|block] [--github-comment]`

---

## Agent integration tips

1. Read `/llms.txt` (this file) first, then fetch only the doc URL from the routing table above.
2. Prefer `/docs/reference#<anchor>` over scrolling the full reference page.
3. In tests, always set `per_process_ledger=False` / `perProcessLedger: false` when asserting ledger file paths.
4. Do not patch and wrap the same call path — check `patch_status` / `patchStatus` in health output.
5. For serverless, never rely on background flush alone; flush explicitly before return.
